title: Produced robot skins and service props — native D review
notes: Actual Godot captures of Needle Surveyor (skirmisher), Caisson Guard (bulwark), Kiln Tender (mortar), their LODs and six support props. Images and video are copied unchanged from production D; click images for full resolution.
Production props are shallow service fixtures mounted on existing Emberline cover faces, preserving source collision. They do not introduce new repair or workshop mechanics.

Campaign views use controlled production-authority replay, not a hosted ordinary-input journey. Native animation video uses actual capture timestamps: 120 captures over 21.637081 seconds. Renderer: llvmpipe. This is not hardware-GPU performance or human-feel acceptance; final release verification remains pending.
